units.source_text: “他是不是这样想的，我是个女人，说不好。

en.t: Whether he thinks that way or not, I am a woman, so I cannot really say.

units.source_text: 不过恐怕不是因为这个吧。

en.t: But that probably is not the reason.

units.source_text: 他还是想做点事的，可总是办不到，所以才让人同情呢。”

en.t: He still wants to do something, but he can never manage it, and that is why he is so pitiable.

units.source_text: “不过从身体来看，先生不是没什么病吗？”

en.t: But physically speaking, Sensei does not seem to have anything wrong with him, does he?

units.source_text: “身体很好，什么病也没有。”

en.t: His health is very good. He has no illness at all.

units.source_text: “那为什么不出去做点事呢？”

en.t: Then why does he not go out and do something?

units.source_text: “那就不知道了。

en.t: That is what I do not know.

units.source_text: 我要是知道，也不会这么操心了。

en.t: If I knew, I would not be worrying like this.

units.source_text: 正因为不知道才更让人心疼呀。”

en.t: Precisely because I do not know, it pains me all the more.

units.source_text: 夫人的语气充满了同情，但她嘴边还是挂着微笑。

en.t: Her tone was full of sympathy, but a smile still lingered around her mouth.

units.source_text: 在旁人眼里，我倒显得过于认真。

en.t: Seen from the outside, I must have looked the more overly serious one.

units.source_text: 我满脸困惑，不说话了。

en.t: I sat there with a puzzled look on my face and said nothing.

units.source_text: 夫人像是突然想起什么似的，又说：

en.t: Then, as if she had suddenly remembered something, she spoke again:

units.source_text: “他年轻的时候可不这样，

en.t: When he was young, he was not like this at all.

units.source_text: 年轻时完全不是这个样子，

en.t: In his youth, he was completely different.

units.source_text: 他完全变了一个人。”

en.t: He has become a completely different person.

units.source_text: “您说的年轻的时候，是什么时候？”我问。

en.t: When you say when he was young, what period do you mean? I asked.

units.source_text: “学生时代呀。”

en.t: His student days.

units.source_text: “您从学生时代就认识先生了？”

en.t: You have known Sensei since his student days?

units.source_text: 夫人的脸上突然泛出了红晕。

en.t: A sudden flush rose in her face.
